RDBD.TypeCosts.menuHint: Set the Battle Point cost of each adversary type. Custom types added through Daggerheart's Homebrew settings have no cost of their own and must be priced here before they can be used in an encounter.
RDBD.TypeCosts.title: Adversary BP Costs
RDBD.TypeCosts.intro: The Battle Point cost of one adversary of each type, at the party's own tier. Leave a row blank to use the system's value. Treated As is separate: it makes a custom type follow an official type's rules, but you still set its cost yourself. Ignore takes a type out of every draw without removing anything from a deck.
RDBD.TypeCosts.unpricedWarning: Some adversary types have no cost. They are skipped when filling a budget, and count as 0 BP anywhere else.
RDBD.TypeCosts.ignoreHint: Never draw this type into an encounter. Decks can still hold it and its cost still applies — it is simply never rolled.
RDBD.TypeCosts.ignoredNote: Ignored types are left out of every draw. They stay in their decks and keep their cost; Generate, Draw Another and per-card re-rolls will not offer them.
RDBD.TypeCosts.ignoredTooltip: This adversary's type is ignored, so it will never be drawn into an encounter. Change that under Game Settings > Adversary BP Costs.
RDBD.TypeCosts.treatedAsHint: Make this custom type follow an official type's rules: whether it counts as a Bruiser, Horde, Leader or Solo, and whether one Battle Point buys a whole group. The BP cost is not inherited — set that yourself.
RDBD.TypeCosts.coreHint: The cost the Daggerheart system defines for this type.
RDBD.TypeCosts.unpricedTooltip: This adversary type has no Battle Point cost. Set one under Game Settings > Adversary BP Costs.
RDBD.TypeCosts.costHint: Cost of one of these at the party's own tier. Blank falls back to the system's value.
RDBD.TypeCosts.groupedHint: One Battle Point buys a whole group of party-size creatures, the way minions work.
RDBD.TypeCosts.resetHint: Discard every custom cost and go back to the system's values.
RDBD.TypeCosts.resetConfirm: Discard every custom adversary cost? Homebrew types will go back to having no cost at all.

RDBD.Builder.targetBPHint: Leave blank to use the baseline of 3 x PCs + 2, plus your modifiers.
RDBD.Builder.drawCountHint: Pulls this many adversaries regardless of budget.
RDBD.Builder.drawAnotherHint: Add one more adversary and keep the encounter you already have.
RDBD.Builder.allDecksChosen: Every deck is already in play.
RDBD.Builder.noDecks: No decks yet. Create one to start drawing real adversaries.
RDBD.Builder.decklessNote: No deck selected: the encounter will be generated as a list of adversary categories, with no actors attached.
RDBD.Builder.acceptHint: Lock this encounter. Cards stay draggable.
RDBD.Builder.unlockHint: Unlock to re-roll or edit this encounter again.
RDBD.Builder.rerollHint: Re-roll the whole encounter with the current settings.
RDBD.Builder.resetHint: Clear the roster but keep the builder settings.
RDBD.Builder.cardHint: Click a card to open its sheet, or drag it onto the canvas to place tokens.
RDBD.Builder.notGenerated: Set up the encounter above, then hit Generate.
RDBD.Builder.noResults: Nothing could be drawn. Try raising the budget or adding adversaries to the selected decks.
